commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
[i]I didn't think someone as big as ComptaCorp would ask for my help...
This might be a bit harder than dealing with small businesses.[/i]
?> ->Intro 1
name: start

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
[i]Is this girl the financial manager's trainee or something?
She looks lost.[/i]
?> ->Intro 2
name: Intro 1

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
Good morning! I'm Miss Garter: Potential Energy management plan consultant.
I was supposed to meet with a ComptaCorp representative, to discuss a resource management strategy.
?> ->Intro 3
name: Intro 2

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
H-hello! Yes, that would be me.
?> ->Assessment 1
name: Intro 3

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
[i]Insecure rookie. Simple enough.[/i]
?> ->Assessment 2
name: Assessment 1

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
I'm sure you have no time to waste, so let's get to business, shall we?
What are the company's current issues?
?> ->Assessment 3
name: Assessment 2

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
Well, the company's latest financial report is... worse than usual.
My supervisors tasked me with finding a better resource management strategy.
?> ->Assessment 4
name: Assessment 3

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
I see:
?>Do you already know what to work on?->Assessment 5
?>Any idea what might have caused this?->Assessment 5
name: Assessment 4

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
Well, my seniors let me know ComptaCorp hasn't had a negative report for the last 15 years... That is, until... I made my first management decisions, a few weeks ago.
?>It's perfectly normal for a rookie to make mistakes->Assessment 6
?>Don't jump to conclusions, it could be a coincidence->Assessment 7
name: Assessment 5

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(flickermask,condor,1.5)
signal(changeparam,self_mask_1,1)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
I guess you're right, maybe I should be a little lighter on myself.
But that doesn't change the fact I'm clearly incapable of making the right choice.
If I don't start performing well fast enough, then nobody will help me.
?>I don't think your relationship with your coworkers could ever get that bad->Assessment 8
name: Assessment 6

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(flickermask,fox,1.5)
signal(changeparam,self_mask_2,1)
Do you think so? I guess I've never been lucky...
But even if that was the case, if even more coincidences were to happen... I don't think anyone could ever respect me.
?>I don't think your relationship with your coworkers could ever get that bad->Assessment 8
name: Assessment 7

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
Well, it doesn't have to get worse if never was good in the first place, does it?
The people here... don't seem to like me very much.
Maybe trying to befriend them was too naive? Eh.
?>I think you should focus on your work, you're capable of making friends elsewhere->Assessment 9
?>I could have you bond through collective activities, like continuing education courses->Assessment 10
name: Assessment 8

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(flickermask,fox,1.5)
signal(changeparam,self_mask_2,2)
You're right, the workplace is not meant for socializing.
If I focus on my work, I will probably be fine, even without their help.
I feel that's also what I you're here for, in the first place. They'll have to respect me soon enough.
?>If you don't mind me asking: why are you so worried about relationship with them?->Assessment 11
name: Assessment 9

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(flickermask,condor,1.5)
signal(changeparam,self_mask_1,2)
That... sounds like it could work!
Continuing education almost functions like school, doesn't it?
And lifelong connections are made at school... sometimes even over just a few lessons!
?>If you don't mind me asking: why are you so worried about relationship with them?->Assessment 11
name: Assessment 10

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
Well, I'm currently an intern... meaning my contract is precarious.
If I my next peer review doesn't go well, I might be laid off.
I... really can't afford to be laid off.
?>I'm sure the higher-ups care about your results, more than they care about your peers->Assessment 12
?>More interactions with your peers will build the confidence you lack. You'll change their mind->Assessment 13
name: Assessment 11

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(flickermask,fox,1.5)
signal(changeparam,self_mask_2,2)
That's probably true. After all, my peers are also just employees.
If I could reach the higher-ups, they would appreciate my hard work.
?>I think we should figure out how to help you. What is your current plan like?->Assessment 14
name: Assessment 12

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(flickermask,condor,1.5)
signal(changeparam,self_mask_1,2)
Building confidence... that sounds amazing.
A plan that fixes my confidence would definitely allow me to stay.
?>I think we should figure out how to help you. What is your current plan like?->Assessment 14
name: Assessment 13

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
Where do I start... going into the finer details might be too time consuming...
Long story short: I was too scared to change the energy provider, so I only reduced the amount of energy we use, by reallocating people in the office.
This also slightly reduced their work hours.
?> ->Assessment 15
name: Assessment 14

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
I thought they would love lighter days, but apparently everyone is mad about moving around all the time.
If that wasn't enough, the bills are also pretty much unchanged. A total failure.
?>This needs multiple tweaks, but I could easily fix it for you and turn this situation around->Assessment 16
?>This is impressive for an intern! It would be perfect, but your provider and colleagues are working against you->Assessment 17
name: Assessment 15

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(flickermask,condor,1.5)
signal(changeparam,self_mask_1,3)
R-really? Can you really do that?
You would be my saving grace... this could make up for my mistakes!
?>Would you like to hear my proposal for your new resource management strategy?->Assessment 18
name: Assessment 16

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(flickermask,fox,1.5)
signal(changeparam,self_mask_2,3)
T-they are!? I would never have realized it!
I guess that's the why you're a veteran, and I'm still an intern.
And thank you, I thought it was a solid plan, too.
If I wasn't being sabotaged, the higher-ups would understand.
?>Would you like to hear my proposal for your new resource management strategy?->Assessment 18
name: Assessment 17
Assessment 18

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setmariamask,condor)
signal(maskpopup,Condor)
I don't mean to be harsh dear, but I believe you're still very naive.
This new plan would help you mature, as well.
?> ->ControlCondor 2
name: ControlCondor 1

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(setmariamask,fox)
signal(maskpopup,Fox)
I don't mean to be harsh dear, but I believe you're still very naive.
This provider is truly just siphoning the company's money.
?> ->ControlVolpe 2
name: ControlVolpe 1

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
I'll start by fixing the relationship between you and your peers.
Attending a continuing education course every month will bring you together.
?> ->ControlCondor 3
name: ControlCondor 2

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
The only possible solution is getting rid of them!
Luckily, Potential Energy is primarily an energy provider.
?> ->ControlVolpe 3
name: ControlVolpe 2

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
The course takes a few hours of everyone's time, but it also has a lower energy requirement than regular work.
You would win on both the social and the economic sides of things.
?> ->ControlCondor 4
name: ControlCondor 3

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
Moving on to your actual strategy: your employee relocation shows potential.
Your peers might not like it at first, but they'll adapt to it gradually. I would leave this part untouched.
?> ->ControlVolpe 4
name: ControlVolpe 3

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
Speaking of economy: your currend provider is absolutely scamming you.
Potential Energy can't work miracles, but it can provide you a similar plan at a slighlty lower rate.
?> ->ControlCondor 5
name: ControlCondor 4

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
Obviously, such an elaborate approach would result in some slightly higher management fees.
But Potential Energy would take care of those for you.
?> ->ControlVolpe 5
name: ControlVolpe 4

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
Now, I have to admit that Potential Energy's education courses are somewhat costly.
But they are sure to bring huge improvements to your daily office life.
Your value as a ComptaCorp employee would be undeniable.
?> ->Deal 1
name: ControlCondor 5

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
Overall, this strategy seems slightly more costly at first.
But the productivity increase is going to bring ComptaCorp back to life.
Your value as a ComptaCorp employee would be undeniable.
?> ->Deal 1
name: ControlVolpe 5

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
At this point, my main goal here is to make sure you can keep your job.
I don't think someone as young as you should have it this hard.
Does this sound good to you, too?
I would say this is as ambitious as it can get, for your first real plan.
?> ->Deal 2
name: Deal 1

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
This... seems like a great plan.
?> ->Deal 3
name: Deal 2

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,confident)
signal(showrightsprite)
I'm glad we're on the same page!
Now, I took the liberty of adding a little bit of a white lie to the contract: this part here testifies that you concieved (and are fully responsible for) this strategy.
This way, your contribution to the company's rise wil be undeniable!
Would you like to sign?
?> ->Deal 4
name: Deal 3

commands_raw:
signal(hiderightsprite)
signal(setspeakername,Client)
signal(changeparam,other_mask,1)
Yes... yes, please!
?> ->Deal 5
name: Deal 4

commands_raw:
signal(changerightsprite,maria,base)
signal(showrightsprite)
Thank you for trusting Potential Energy!
We will take good care of you.
?> -> next scene
name: Deal 5

commands_raw: signal(nextscene)
name: next scene
